title: Privacy Policy | Traductor AI
description: Privacy policy for the Traductor AI extension for Google Chrome.
heading: Traductor AI Privacy Policy
intro: Traductor AI is a Google Chrome extension that allows translating selected text within editable fields and web editors using the browser's native translation API.

sections.title: 1. Information collected by the extension
paragraphs: Traductor AI does not collect, sell, or share personal user information.
The extension does not create accounts, does not require login, and does not collect names, addresses, emails, phones, mailing addresses, personal identifiers, or payment information.

sections.title: 2. Data accessed by the extension
items: the text that the user manually selects within an editable field or web editor
the target language preference saved by the user in the browser
sections.closing: This access is only used to perform the function requested by the user: translating the selected text.

sections.title: 3. How data is used
paragraphs: Selected text is used exclusively to:
items: detect the language of the selected snippet
translate that snippet to the target language chosen by the user
replace the selected text with the translation within the page, when requested by the user
sections.closing: The target language preference is stored locally using the browser's storage APIs to remember the user's settings.

sections.title: 4. Data transfer
paragraphs: Traductor AI does not transmit data to the developer's own servers.
The extension uses native browser APIs such as Translator and LanguageDetector, available in Google Chrome. The operation of those APIs depends on the user's browser.

sections.title: 5. Storage
paragraphs: The extension only stores locally the basic configuration necessary to function, such as the target language selected by the user.
No translation histories, credentials, messages, or user profiles are stored.

sections.title: 6. Data sharing
paragraphs: Traductor AI does not sell data, does not rent data, and does not share personal data with third parties for advertising, analytics, or marketing purposes.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: The extension is designed to minimize access to data and limit its use to the main translation function expressly requested by the user.

sections.title: 8. Children
paragraphs: Traductor AI is not specifically directed to children and does not knowingly collect personal information from minors.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be updated if the extension's functionality changes. The date of the last update will be indicated at the beginning of this document.
